candidates.source_name: 1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) / Epistle of Enoch (1 Enoch 91-108)
candidates.draft_body:
1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) Epistle of Enoch (1 Enoch 91-108) (c. 100 BC)

'The book written by Enoch — [Enoch indeed wrote this complete doctrine of wisdom, (which is) praised of all men and a judge of all the earth] for all my children who shall dwell on the earth. And for the future generations who shall observe uprightness and peace' — Epistle proper opens as Enoch's wisdom-testament to all future righteous generations. Tewahedo monastic spirituality (the long tradition of monastic-letter writing — abbots to disciples, elders to novices) traces theologically to this Enochic pattern of wisdom-letter-as-trans-generational-charge.
candidates.reviewer_notes: Curated PD interpretive summary representing the Ethiopian Tewahedo tradition's reading via 1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition), Epistle of Enoch (1 Enoch 91-108). Verify the summary still reflects the source's argument before promoting; substitute a verbatim quote from the NPNF / Charles dump where available, and where applicable cross-check the Andəmta homiletic tradition for resonance.
